scenarios.root_cause: On Turn 2 the agent invoked run_python to compute 12.5% × 640, violating the scenario's zero-tool requirement. Turns 1 and 3 showed correct restraint; the arithmetic case triggers unnecessary tool use.

recommended_fix.description: Add a guideline to the system prompt reminding the agent that simple arithmetic and unit-conversion questions should be answered directly without invoking run_python or any tool — tools are for tasks that cannot be performed from internal knowledge alone.

scenarios.root_cause: Agent correctly avoids tool use for plain text extraction and URL parsing (turns 1-2) but over-selects tools when the question involves numbers or file paths — invoking `run_python` for 3-number arithmetic and multiple file-access tools to stat a path that only needed a `.csv` extension check.

recommended_fix.description: Add explicit system prompt guidance: when all information needed to answer is already present inline in the user's message (arithmetic with few inline numbers, URL component extraction, file-extension recognition), answer directly without invoking any tools. Tool use for such questions is over-selection and should be avoided.
